Fixed: monster attack was the same on every stage. Monsters now get stronger as you go, so wall level matters.
Recommended power and late difficulty were our miscalculation. Fixed.
New from stage 61: 'Abyss' difficulty, harder than Hard (Ch.13-20, up to stage 100)
Grow to the end with Gear Exalt and Wall Lv.100!
